migration_flags: fleet.vehicle.cost model DOES NOT EXIST in v19 — cost tracking split into fleet.vehicle.log.services (service costs) and fleet.vehicle.log.contract (contract costs)
acquisition_date field name in v19 (NOT acqui_date as in older versions)
drive_type field NEW on fleet.vehicle.model: fwd/awd/rwd/4wd selection (fleet/models/fleet_vehicle_model.py:66-71)
vehicle_properties_definition (PropertiesDefinition) NEW on fleet.vehicle.model — requires migration of any custom properties
vehicle_properties (Properties) field NEW on fleet.vehicle linked to model definition
vehicle_range + range_unit fields NEW on both fleet.vehicle.model and fleet.vehicle
fleet_vehicle_state_waiting_list is DEMO-ONLY data — not installed in production; code references it with raise_if_not_found=False
fleet.vehicle.log.services.state is a 4-value selection (new/running/done/cancelled) — new explicit lifecycle in v19
_get_odometer uses order='value desc' — returns MAX recorded value, NOT most recent date
fleet.service.type unifies contract and service type in a single model with category discriminator

vehicle_key_fields.state_id: Many2one fleet.vehicle.state — free-form, no code transitions — fleet_vehicle.py:78
vehicle_key_fields.odometer: Float computed — max value from odometer log — fleet_vehicle.py:90

key_findings.odometer_pattern: fleet.vehicle._get_odometer searches fleet.vehicle.odometer order='value desc' limit=1 — returns highest value stored
key_findings.multi_company: company_id on vehicle, log.services, log.contract; check_company on contract.vehicle_id and vehicle.future_driver_id
key_findings.contract_cron: daily cron run_scheduler(): promotes futur→open, open→expired; schedules renewal activities within delay_alert_contract days (default 30)
